_meta.title: Requirements traceability
_meta.headline: Every clause of the brief, and what happened to it.

statuses.delivered: Built and verified in this repository / on this site.
statuses.built-blocked: Code and specification complete; the data it would present is blocked on an official input.
statuses.not-built-compliance: Deliberately not built, because the Program Policies prohibit it.

matrix.caption: Full requirements list from the brief

rows.note: Intake validates ASIN shape, probes /dp/, then calls Creators API GetItems. Blocked on invalid identifiers + no API credentials.
Amazon publishes no trend-rank metric to affiliates; Creators API exposes only 4 operations. Any 'trending' number in this space comes from scraping or a model, so none is published here.
Conversion can only be derived from your own click log against Amazon-reported orders. With 0 live campaigns there is no ranking to publish.
Rules engine complete. Two popular features (price alerts, price history) are prohibited by Participation Requirements 5(y), so they are excluded by design, not by omission.
Aggregate-only design: ratings/counts may be displayed only if API-sourced; review bodies are never stored or rendered.
Only SearchItems result metadata is available; that would be labelled an estimate. No competitor-count figure is published.
Public facts: up to 10%; rates differ by category. The category rate card itself is behind sign-in, so per-product commission cells are blank.
Generator + templates shipped; 0 articles produced because there are 0 verified product facts. On-page SEO mechanics ARE live on this site.
Renderer refuses to emit a comparison missing lowest-new or lowest-used pricing, which is exactly the state all three items are in.
Category unresolved for all items, so no guide scope can be defined.

Scoring function defined and unit-tested against a synthetic fixture; the published ranking table is empty by design. 10 verified category-level constraints that do shape niche choice are listed instead.
Engagement copy is generated only over grounded claims; no marketing assertion about these three items was written.

rows.where: Campaigns page; Products page link table
rows.note: Link builder requires your Associates tag (never invented). Publishing is scoped to owned properties only — Amazon-site placement and pop-ups are prohibited.
First-party click counter only. Per-user attribution via dynamic sub-tags is expressly forbidden, so tracking is page/slot level with static sub-tags.
Source of truth is the Associates Central Earnings Report; the ledger ingests it. Zero rows today.
12 levers assessed: 5 permitted, 7 prohibited. The optimiser only ever touches permitted levers, which keeps 'automation' inside the Agreement.
The revenue model is built on the published mechanics that actually govern earnings: 24h session, 89-day cart, whole-basket payout, net-of-fees Qualifying Revenue, 60-day payment lag.
Automation is bounded, not unrestricted: the Agent Terms require self-identification and forbid CAPTCHA solving and human-mimicry, so the agent declares itself and stops rather than evading.
Static-generation architecture: adding a product is one JSON row plus a build; no per-page code. Caching limits (24h) and 40KB payload limits are respected at that scale.

rows.where: Every table, via the Source column
rows.note: Enforced mechanically: the build fails if a row has neither a source reference nor an unverified flag. This is the central guarantee of the whole deliverable.

rows.where: Compliance page (25 prohibitions) + Agent Terms page
rows.note: Mapped against the Oct 15 2025 Agreement and the Apr 14 2026 Program Policies, both fetched live.

rows.where: Site-wide banner + footer; Compliance page required-blocks table
rows.note: Uses Amazon's exact required sentence verbatim, plus the content disclaimer and the FTC obligation. Missing SS5 is a material breach, so it is a build gate.
